properties.query:
SOURCE '/aws/systemsmanager/ssm-errors' | fields @timestamp, @message
| filter @message like /ERROR/ or @message like /failed/
| parse @message /(?<instance>i-[a-z0-9]+)/
| parse @message /ERROR\s+(?<error_summary>.{1,100})/
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 10
properties.title: SSM Agent Errors

properties.query:
SOURCE '/aws/systemsmanager/dsc-files' | fields @timestamp, @message
| parse @message /\[(?<level>\w+)\]/
| parse @message /Server Role: (?<role>\w+)/
| parse @message /(?<summary>[^\n]{1,80})/
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 15
properties.title: DSC Execution Details

properties.query:
SOURCE '/aws/systemsmanager/dsc-files' | fields @timestamp, @message, @logStream
| filter @message like /ERROR/ or @message like /failed/ or @message like /Starting/ or @message like /Completed/
| parse @logStream /(?<instance_id>i-[a-z0-9]+)/
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 10
properties.title: Critical Events by Instance (DSC Files)

properties.query:
SOURCE '/aws/systemsmanager/ssm-errors' | fields @timestamp, @message, @logStream
| filter @message like /ERROR/ or @message like /failed/
| parse @logStream /(?<instance_id>i-[a-z0-9]+)/
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 10
properties.title: Critical Events by Instance (SSM Errors)
